name: Release v2.1.271
summary: Claude Code v2.1.271: fast mode in remote sessions, per-command allowed_domains sandboxing, host config snapshots and many fixes.
description: Release notes for Claude Code v2.1.271 (anthropics/claude-code), released 14 Sep 2026 with 73 commits to main. Adds fast mode in Remote sessions, mouse support in the /config panel, claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file, per-command allowed_domains for Bash, PowerShell and Monitor in auto mode, omitClaudeMd for subagents, --accept-command for plugin install and update, and modelPricing multipliers above 1. Fixes cover organization policy caching, MCP OAuth client registrations, Bash permission checks and terminal rendering.
contains: fast mode in Remote sessions (cloud and self-hosted runners)
per-command allowed_domains sandboxing for Bash, PowerShell and Monitor
omitClaudeMd for subagents; --accept-command for plugin install and update
fixes: organization policy caching, MCP OAuth client registrations, Bash permission checks
